blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The Quezon provincial government imposed a four-day liquor ban in all public and private cemeteries across the province for a safe, peaceful and solemn observance of ‘Undas’ (All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day). According to Executive Order (EO) No. DHT-30, “bringing, drinking, distributing and selling liquor and other alcoholic beverages inside or within the compound of private and public cemeteries, memorial parks, columbaria and other similar places” are prohibited. The directive was signed by Vice Gov. Anacleto Alcala III, who is serving as acting governor, and issued on Thursday, Oct. 29. The ban took effect at midnight […]...
